## Description
Briefly describe the change, rationale, and impact on streaming throughput or detection quality.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Benchmark / Experiment addition or update
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / optimization

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`pytest tests/`)
- [ ] Zero temporal data leakage verified (`python experiments/verify_no_leakage.py`)
